verdict.rationale: Brex markets its own AI agents and assistants, so asking whether they can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Brex's official MCP server, which is the server role: it exposes Brex data to outside AI assistants. Nothing shows Brex can act as an MCP client and plug in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.
